name: Hektas Ticaret T.A.S.
summary: Hektas Ticaret T.A.S. manufactures, imports, and markets agricultural products, fertilizers and veterinary medicines in Turkey. The company's crop protection products include fungicides, herbicides, insecticides, acaricides, fumigants and nemathists, harvesting aids and plant growth regulators, winter struggle medicines and summer oils, spreads-adhesives, biological products, and feromons. It also offers smart base, leaf, pure, and fertilizers; organominerals; drip irrigation; biological preparation; and other plant nutrition products.
